Nicolas Cage Says He Is Living in Hotels After Malibu Sinkhole Damage

Actor Nicolas Cage recently shared an update regarding his living arrangements, stating that he is currently staying in hotels following severe property damage caused by a massive sinkhole in Malibu. According to reported accounts from a public appearance, the actor addressed his situation during a panel discussion.

Malibu Property Damage and Evacuations

The incident began when a large sinkhole formed near properties in Malibu. Reports indicate the following details about the event:

  • The geological event involved a substantial collapse that affected driveways and structural decks.
  • Local officials implemented evacuations affecting multiple properties in the immediate vicinity due to restricted access for residents and emergency responders.
  • Concerns were also raised regarding potential gas leaks in the area, prompting a local emergency declaration by Malibu officials.
  • No injuries were reported in connection with the sinkhole collapse.

Public Comments and Holiday Plans

During an appearance at Los Angeles Comic Con, Cage spoke about his current lifestyle while discussing upcoming holiday plans.

  • Living Situation: Cage remarked that he is "a little bit homeless" and staying in hotels while repairs or assessments are underway.
  • Celebration Plans: Despite not being at his Malibu home, he planned to take his young daughter trick-or-treating in Santa Monica and watch a classic film later in the evening.
